Extend the search if the initial pass did not cover the full period.
Done when the look-back period is confirmed fully covered.
verify: Review the search parameters against the required period.
Pass when the full period is covered.

steps.title: Report positive matches to FinCEN within the response window
sop: Report any positive match to FinCEN within the mandated response window.
Confirm the report is submitted before the window closes.
Done when positive matches are reported within the window.
verify: Check the submission timestamp against the mandated window.
Pass when it is within the window.

steps.title: Log negative-result searches as complete
sop: Log negative-result searches to evidence a complete search was performed.
Confirm the log entry references the search parameters used.
Done when negative results are logged with search parameters.
verify: Review the log for negative-result entries and parameters.
Pass when neither is missing.

steps.title: File the completed 314(a) response record
sop: File the completed response record with submission confirmation.
Confirm the record is retrievable for future examiner review.
Done when the response record is filed and retrievable.
verify: Search the repository for the filed response record.
Pass when it is found with submission confirmation.

steps.title: Confirm the filed response record is complete for the request
sop: Retrieve the filed 314(a) response record from the repository.
Confirm the search coverage, matches reported and submission confirmation are all present.
Done when the response record is confirmed complete for the request.
verify: Open the filed record and check for completeness.
Pass when none of the required elements is missing.

generic.Defined scope/population: AML records retained under the BSA five-year retention schedule
generic.In-scope period: Five years from the record's closure date, extended where a legal hold applies
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention tag, legal-hold flag and disposal-eligibility fields all confirmed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disposed-record count reconciles to records confirmed past retention with no hold
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Retention-compliance audit result documented for the sample reviewed
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Retention gaps found during the audit logged with a remediation action
generic.Test population: Sample of AML record types tested in the periodic retention-compliance audit
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if no record type is found past its retention period without a legal hold
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate confirmed retention gaps to the Compliance Analyst's supervisor
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No AML record type found past its five-year retention period without a legal hold
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository retention schedule record

steps.title: Apply the five-year retention tag at record closure
sop: Apply the five-year retention tag to CTRs, SARs, CDD files and case records.
Confirm the tag is applied at the point of case or file closure.
Done when every closed record type carries the retention tag.
verify: Review a sample of closed records for the retention tag.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Confirm records past retention have no legal hold before disposal
sop: Confirm records scheduled for disposal have passed the five-year retention period.
Confirm no legal hold applies to these records.
Done when disposal eligibility is confirmed for every scheduled record.
verify: Review the disposal list for retention-period and hold-flag checks.
Pass when both are confirmed for every record.

steps.title: Verify legal-hold flags override the standard schedule
sop: Verify legal-hold flags correctly override the standard retention/disposal schedule.
Confirm no held record is included in the disposal batch.
Done when legal-hold overrides are confirmed correctly applied.
verify: Review the disposal batch against the legal-hold flag list.
Pass when no held record is present.

steps.title: Run the periodic retention-compliance audit
sop: Run the periodic audit against a sample of AML record types.
Document the audit results for each sampled type.
Done when the audit is run and results documented.
verify: Review the audit results for completeness by record type.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Document any retention gap and remediation action
sop: Document any retention gap identified in the audit.
Document the remediation action taken or planned.
Done when every identified gap has a documented remediation.
verify: Review the audit findings for a remediation entry on each gap.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Confirm the audit result is filed with no unresolved gap
sop: File the retention-compliance audit result in the compliance evidence repository.
Confirm every identified gap has a remediation action recorded.
Done when the audit result is filed with no unresolved gap.
verify: Open the filed audit result and check for unresolved gaps.
Pass when none is found.

generic.Defined scope/population: Periodic AML regulatory filings submitted with acknowledgments captured
generic.In-scope period: The current filing cycle through submission and acknowledgment
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing preparation, review, submission and acknowledgment fields all completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Submitted-filing count reconciles to the cycle's filing inventory
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submission acknowledgment captured and recorded for each filing
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filings missing an acknowledgment within the expected turnaround escalated
generic.Test population: Sample of cycle filings checked against the filing inventory for completeness
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if all cycle filings are submitted with acknowledgments captured and reconciled
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate missing acknowledgments to the Compliance Analyst past the expected turnaround
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All cycle filings submitted with acknowledgments captured and reconciled
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform periodic filing tracker

steps.title: Confirm each periodic filing is prepared and reviewed
sop: Confirm each CTR, SAR or other BSA report due in the cycle is prepared.
Confirm each has completed reviewer sign-off.
Done when every due filing is prepared and reviewed.
verify: Review the filing inventory for preparation and review status.
Pass when neither is missing per filing.

steps.title: Submit filings via the applicable electronic filing channel
sop: Submit each filing via the applicable FinCEN or regulator electronic channel.
Confirm the submission completes without error.
Done when every due filing is submitted successfully.
verify: Review the submission log for successful completion per filing.
Pass when none shows an error.

steps.title: Capture and record the submission acknowledgment
sop: Capture the submission acknowledgment for each filing.
Record the acknowledgment against the filing record.
Done when every filing has a recorded acknowledgment.
verify: Review the filing records for the acknowledgment field.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Reconcile the cycle's submitted-filing count
sop: Reconcile the submitted-filing count against the filing inventory.
Identify any discrepancy between the two.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and any gap resolved.
verify: Compare the submitted count to the inventory count.
Pass when they match.

steps.title: Escalate filings missing an acknowledgment
sop: Identify filings missing an acknowledgment within the expected turnaround.
Escalate these filings for follow-up.
Done when every missing-acknowledgment filing is escalated.
verify: Review the tracker for missing acknowledgments without escalation.
Pass when none is found.

steps.title: Confirm the cycle's filing tracker is reconciled and closed
sop: Review the filing tracker for the completed cycle.
Confirm every filing is submitted, acknowledged and reconciled.
Done when the tracker is confirmed reconciled and closed for the cycle.
verify: Open the tracker and check for open items at cycle close.
Pass when none remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open SAR, CTR and other BSA filing obligations through to closure
generic.In-scope period: From obligation creation until the actual filing date is logged
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deadline, priority flag, escalation and closure-date fields all completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed-obligation count reconciles weekly to the filing register
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker reconciled to the filing register with the actual filing date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filings within five days of deadline or at risk of missing it escalated
generic.Test population: Sample of closed obligations checked against the filing register
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if no open filing obligation is past its statutory deadline unescalated
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate at-risk filings to the Financial Crime AML Officer immediately
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No open filing obligation past its statutory deadline without an escalation logged
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform AML filing deadline tracker

steps.title: Maintain the AML filing deadline tracker
sop: Maintain the tracker covering all open SAR, CTR and other BSA obligations.
Confirm every open obligation has a logged statutory deadline.
Done when the tracker reflects every open obligation with a deadline.
verify: Review the tracker for obligations missing a deadline.
Pass when none is found.

steps.title: Flag filings within five days of the statutory deadline
sop: Identify filings within five days of their statutory deadline.
Flag these filings for priority handling.
Done when every filing within five days is flagged.
verify: Review the tracker for unflagged filings within five days.
Pass when none is found.

steps.title: Escalate filings at risk of missing the deadline
sop: Identify filings at risk of missing their deadline.
Escalate these to the Financial Crime AML Officer.
Done when every at-risk filing is escalated.
verify: Review the tracker for at-risk filings without escalation.
Pass when none is found.

steps.title: Confirm completed filings are marked closed with the actual date
sop: Mark each completed filing closed in the tracker.
Record the actual filing date on the closed entry.
Done when every completed filing is closed with the actual date recorded.
verify: Review closed entries for the recorded actual filing date.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Reconcile the tracker against the filing register weekly
sop: Reconcile the tracker against the filing register on the weekly cadence.
Correct any discrepancy found.
Done when the weekly reconciliation is complete with no open discrepancy.
verify: Compare the tracker and register counts for the week.
Pass when they match.

steps.title: Confirm the weekly reconciliation shows no unescalated overdue item
sop: Review the weekly reconciliation result between tracker and register.
Confirm no obligation past its statutory deadline lacks an escalation.
Done when the weekly reconciliation confirms no unescalated overdue item.
verify: Check the reconciliation result for overdue items without escalation.
Pass when none is found.

generic.Defined scope/population: AML regulatory reporting calendar for the upcoming year
generic.In-scope period: The upcoming calendar/fiscal year of filing obligations
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing deadline, recurring cadence and responsible-owner fields all completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Calendar entry count matches the current-year SAR, CTR and other BSA filing obligations
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Current-year calendar published to the compliance evidence repository
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deadline changes from new guidance or GTOs logged with the update source
generic.Test population: Sample of calendar entries checked against current FinCEN guidance
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if the calendar reflects current deadlines and is published to the reporting team
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unresolved deadline conflicts to the Financial Crime AML Officer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calendar updated with current deadlines and published to the AML reporting team
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository regulatory reporting calendar

steps.title: Review current-year regulatory deadlines
sop: Review current-year deadlines for SAR, CTR and other periodic BSA/AML filings.
Confirm each deadline is captured accurately.
Done when all current-year deadlines are reviewed and confirmed.
verify: Compare the reviewed deadlines to the regulatory source documents.
Pass when none is missing or inaccurate.

steps.title: Incorporate changes from new guidance or exam cycles
sop: Incorporate changes from new FinCEN guidance or GTOs.
Incorporate changes from updated examination cycle dates.
Done when both types of changes are incorporated into the calendar.
verify: Review the calendar for the incorporated changes.
Pass when neither source of change is missing.

steps.title: Update the calendar with deadlines and responsible owners
sop: Update the calendar with each filing's recurring deadline.
Update the calendar with the responsible owner for each filing.
Done when every filing has a deadline and owner recorded.
verify: Review the calendar for deadline and owner fields per filing.
Pass when neither is missing.

steps.title: Circulate the updated calendar to the reporting team
sop: Circulate the updated calendar to the AML reporting team.
Circulate the calendar to the Financial Crime AML Officer.
Done when both audiences have received the updated calendar.
verify: Check the distribution log for both recipients.
Pass when neither is missing.

steps.title: Publish the current-year calendar to the evidence repository
sop: Publish the current-year calendar to the compliance evidence repository.
Confirm the published version is the most current one.
Done when the current-year calendar is published and retrievable.
verify: Open the repository and confirm the published calendar version.
Pass when it matches the current year.

steps.title: Confirm the published calendar is the current version in use
sop: Open the compliance evidence repository for the published calendar.
Confirm the AML reporting team is using the current-year version.
Done when the published calendar is confirmed current and in active use.
verify: Check the repository and reporting team usage for the current version.
Pass when both reflect the current-year calendar.
